formats.student_task: Choose the single correct option and write it.
formats.expected_answer_length: One option label (a/b/c/d) plus the option value in the answer key.
wording_constraints: Hindi stem.
Exactly four options labelled (a) (b) (c) (d).
One unambiguously correct option.
Keep mathematical symbols in standard notation; do not prose-ify formulas.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Must have exactly one correct option under Class 10 NCERT definitions. Distractors should be plausible calculation or concept errors, not nonsense.

suitability.BOOK: NCERT exercises are rarely native MCQs. Derive an MCQ from an eligible exercise/example concept and mark source_type=book_adapted with the source question id.
suitability.NEW: Create a fresh MCQ from allowed topic excerpts only.

validation_rules: exactly one correct option recorded in answer key

examples.style_note: Short Hindi stem about rational/irrational classification, four options, one correct. Inspired by sample Q1 style, not copied.

formats.student_task: Write the missing word, number, or short expression.
formats.expected_answer_length: One word, number, or short formula.
wording_constraints: One blank per subquestion.
Hindi sentence with a clear blank.
Blank should have a unique short answer.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Answer must follow a stated NCERT identity, definition, or unique computation from the allowed portion.

suitability.BOOK: Prefer blanks that restate an eligible book identity (for example HCF×LCM). Mark book_adapted if translated or slightly reworded.
suitability.NEW: New numbers/context allowed; concept must stay inside allowed topics.

examples.style_note: Identity or definition completion, e.g. HCF(a,b)×LCM(a,b)=ab. Sample-paper style, original wording.

wording_constraints: A complete Hindi statement.
Clearly true or clearly false against the allowed textbook content.
Avoid trick punctuation; do not mix two claims.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Truth value must be decidable from the allowed chapters. False statements should invert a real definition or theorem, not introduce out-of-syllabus objects.

suitability.BOOK: Restate or negate a book fact from an eligible exercise/section.
suitability.NEW: New wording from allowed concepts only.

examples.style_note: Direct statement such as '√5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है' — sample style, not a copy of the sample list.

formats.student_task: Match each item in column A with the correct item in column B.
wording_constraints: Column A has 6 prompts.
Column B has 6 matches (order shuffled).
Each A item has exactly one correct B partner.
Hindi labels; math symbols kept intact.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Pairs must be uniquely correct. Do not reuse the same B item for two A items.

suitability.BOOK: Use only natural one-to-one book relationships (HCF value, degree, discriminant, unique/parallel/coincident conditions). Never force a normal solve/prove exercise into MATCH by splitting it into filler words (multiply, expand, equation, calculation, verification).
suitability.NEW: New pairings from allowed topics only.

validation_rules: each A has exactly one defensible B
every pair traces to allowed book chapter/topic/page

examples.style_note: A-side: standard form / zeroes / HCF prompt. B-side: matching expression or value. Sample Q4 layout, original pairs.

formats.student_task: Answer in one word or one sentence.
formats.expected_answer_length: At most one sentence or a short formula.
wording_constraints: Ask for a definition, condition, standard form, or named theorem from the allowed portion.
Do not require multi-step working.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Answer must be the NCERT-standard statement or formula from the allowed chapters.

suitability.BOOK: Use definitions/theorems that appear in eligible sections (FTA, cubic standard form, consistent pair).

examples.style_note: Request a named theorem or standard form in one sentence, as in sample Q5, without copying those six stems.

formats.student_task: Give a brief working or a short result with essential steps.
wording_constraints: One focused task: find zeroes, write squares/cubes, state a short formula, solve a tiny case.
Hindi instructions; keep algebra in symbols.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Working must be complete enough for 2 marks: method + answer, or a correctly stated result.

suitability.BOOK: Prefer actual exercise items of similar size (find zeroes of a given polynomial). Preserve numbers when source_type=book; if translated only, still book_adapted.
suitability.NEW: Change numbers/context; stay inside allowed chapters.

validation_rules: answer key has result and brief steps

examples.style_note: Find zeroes of a small quadratic, or write a short definition. Sample Q6-Q17 length, original polynomials.

formats.student_task: Solve with working; may include two small parts.
formats.expected_answer_length: About half a page / 4 to 8 steps.
wording_constraints: May use (i) (ii) subparts that together are 3 marks.
Require verification or a constructed polynomial, not only a one-line recall.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Must need a method (factorisation, relations of zeroes and coefficients, or a two-part check).

suitability.BOOK: Use eligible exercise items of this size, e.g. zeroes plus coefficient check.
suitability.NEW: New coefficients from allowed polynomial / equation topics.

examples.style_note: Two small quadratics: find zeroes and verify sum/product vs coefficients. Sample Q18 style, original items.

formats.student_task: Give a structured solution: proof or full method for a pair of equations / nature of roots.
formats.expected_answer_length: A full solution with reasons; typically 8+ steps or a short proof.
wording_constraints: Hindi narrative for proof language; algebra in symbols.
Do not ask for constructions or chapters outside the allowed set.
formats.mathematical_rigor: Proofs must use the allowed chapter method (e.g. contradiction for √p). Equation solutions must show a complete algebraic method.

suitability.BOOK: Use eligible prove/solve exercise items (irrationality proofs, linear pair, nature of roots).
suitability.NEW: New numbers; same methods from allowed chapters only.

examples.style_note: Prove a specific square root is irrational, or solve a pair of linear equations. Sample Q21-Q23 style, original numbers.
